$Comment: The way into Hallow's Eve: go and find Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple. It arms itself:
Flow.AutoAccept puts it in every player's quest log while the event runs, at their next login or
world change, and the base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker. The _Hallows_Eve folder makes
the id hallows_eve_old_jack_meet.
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at the giver: nothing to bring, only the
walk. While it is under way, Old Jack's first screen opens his quest list on it, where the player
hands it in and collects its pay, a Claim like every quest's: Hallows_Eve_Meet_Pay (a small
welcome of sweets) and the rows beside it. Collecting it there plays his conversation again, and
its beat with the OnceId meet_patch_offer opens on Pumpkin Patch's offer. It names no TurnInAt, so
the pay can also be collected from the quest log anywhere.
The Not group keeps it from anyone who already finished Pumpkin Patch, and with no Repeat it pays
once per player, ever. A player who abandons it before finishing Pumpkin Patch gets it back: an
abandoned quest reads as never taken, so the Quests tab of the player's quest menu offers Accept
for it at once (a quest that arms itself is never taken only at its giver), the next auto-accept
pass (a login, a world change, or another of their quests finishing) arms it again, and Old Jack's
conversation offers it, its answer taking it and opening his quest list on it. Its Listing turns the
base's Hidden off so the Quests tab lists it while it is untaken; the inherited
RequirePrerequisites still keeps it off that list for anyone past Pumpkin Patch. The same ways
back reach a player whose quest log was full when this tried to arm. Once handed in it cannot be
abandoned, so its pay always waits to be collected. Pumpkin Patch does not wait on it: a player
without it still gets the questline from Old Jack.
The Item row hands over the library's Objective Book, the way into every quest and achievement list,
so a server with this pack and no MMO Skill Tree has a way to get one; a player who already holds
one from another mod gets a second.
Beside the table, MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row pays Acrobatics XP for the walk down, in Claim with the
rest. A server without that mod skips the row and shows nothing for it.
Name: Old_Jack_Meet
